proposed.text: A school corridor door has a metal plate on the lower face to resist scuffs and impact from foot traffic and cleaning equipment. Which hardware item is this?

rationale.summary: A kick plate protects the lower part of the door leaf from impact and wear.
rationale.explanation: The function in the stem is surface protection. A strike receives a latch; a threshold treats the floor/sill transition; a cylinder is part of lock operation/security.
rationale.takeaway: Lower-face protection from scuffs = kick plate.
